title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 28th (AAPL, ALV, BAS, DBK, ENI, FB, GM, HDD, JEN, MOR) - Week Herald

Tweet
Analysts’ price target changes for Monday, January 28th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $180.00 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Allianz (FRA:ALV) was given a €225.00 ($261.63) target price by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Basf (ETR:BAS) was given a €75.00 ($87.21) price target by analysts at Barclays PLC. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Deutsche Bank (FRA:DBK) was given a €7.80 ($9.07) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
ENI (ETR:ENI) was given a €18.50 ($21.51) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Facebook (NASDAQ:FB) was given a $195.00 price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
General Motors (NYSE:GM) (TSE:GMM.U) had its price target boosted by BMO Capital Markets from $79.00 to $84.00.
Heidelberger Druckmaschinen (ETR:HDD) was given a €2.50 ($2.91) target price by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Jenoptik (ETR:JEN) was given a €32.50 ($37.79) price target by analysts at Hauck & Aufhaeuser. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
MorphoSys (ETR:MOR) was given a €135.00 ($156.98) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Renault (EPA:RNO) was given a €73.00 ($84.88) target price by analysts at HSBC Holdings plc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
RWE (FRA:RWE) was given a €24.50 ($28.49) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Snap (NYSE:SNAP) had its price target reduced by Credit Suisse Group AG from $12.00 to $9.50. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Swiss Re (VTX:SREN) was given a CHF 115 price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Uniper (ETR:UN01) was given a €28.50 ($33.14) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Uniper (ETR:UN01) was given a €23.10 ($26.86) price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
